name: 19382 · West Chester, PA
findings: ZIP 19382 (West Chester) has 229 nonprofit organizations. 113 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 84 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19382 (West Chester) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
47% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19382 (West Chester) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 56% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
